description: Wasserschutzgebiet im Verfahren Landkreis Diepholz is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geo.diepholz.de. The portal shows the English title as "Water protection area in the district of Diepholz" (machine-translated by the portal). The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
